notes: «خرجت بسلاحي» is a first-person narrative: the implicit transmitter is al-Hasan, and whether it is a link needs a ruling (rule 11).
Abu Bakra is the Companion who relays the Prophet's words («قال رسول الله»): last link of the first route.
Hammad's remark «فذكرت هذا الحديث لأيوب ويونس» names Hasan, al-Ahnaf b. Qays and Abu Bakra for the same saying: a variant group (rule 4). Ayyub and Yunus are speakers in that remark, not links.
«حدثنا سليمان حدثنا حماد بهذا» is a second isnad with the same saying; «بهذا» is kept as back_reference.
